changelog:
- [Feature] Added Advanced Format Converter: Support local audio/video file drag-and-drop, conversion to MP3, WAV, FLAC, M4A, MP4, MKV, WebM, GIF with customizable audio bitrate and video resolution options.
- [Feature] High-Quality GIF Generator: Implemented a 2-step FFmpeg palettegen/paletteuse process to produce sharp, grain-free animated GIFs.
- [Feature] Integrated Subtitle Editor: Allow editing cue texts and timestamps (expanded inputs preventing millisecond truncation) in preview modal, synced directly to backend FFmpeg for softsub/hardsub export.
- [UI/UX] Added a sleek Tab navigation bar (Downloader / Format Converter) with real-time XHR upload progress indicators.
- [UI/UX] Refined GIF conversion progress reporting: Split into Phase 1 (Palettegen - 5%) and Phase 2 (Paletteuse - 15%+) to eliminate 0% progress freezes on large videos.
- [UI/UX] Fixed subtitle header wrapping by shortening buttons to "Edit Mode"/"View Mode" and enforcing nowrap styling.
- [UI/UX] Resolved the black-bar letterboxing issue on "Fit to media size" action by dynamically measuring live DOM elements (header, footer, margins, borders, and sidebar width) instead of using static hardcoded magic numbers.
- [Bug Fix] Preserved card internal vertical flex layout spacing (16px gap) by adding flex styles to the newly introduced `.main-tab-content` container wrapper.
- [Bug Fix] Resolved server startup cleanup race condition deleting the uploads cache folder by introducing on-upload lazy creation checks.
- [Bug Fix] Corrected FFmpeg unsharp filter parameter typos (luma_msize_x/y) to restore video sharpening and enhancement features during download.
